title: Interpretable many-body interaction laws for collective motion from few trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2611.08314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Models of collective motion usually reduce social interactions to pairwise forces, despite empirical evidence for many-body effects. We introduce the directional atomic cluster expansion (dACE), which adapts the atomic cluster expansion (ACE) of interatomic potentials to self-propelled agents. dACE provides a systematically improvable, exactly equivariant expansion of an agent's acceleration that splits uniquely into 1-, 2-, 3-body and higher contributions, along with a self term for the agent's own past motion that is fitted so that it does not absorb the interactions. On simulated collectives in two and three dimensions with known rules, dACE recovers the interaction law body order by body order from little data, while the neural model SocialNet, the current closest competitor, needs more data, has much larger errors on many-body or chiral rules and is restricted to 2D. translated_title: 从少量轨迹中学习集体运动的可解释多体相互作用规律
translated_abstract: 集体运动模型通常将个体间的社会相互作用简化为两体力，尽管已有实证证据表明存在多体效应。我们提出了方向原子簇展开（dACE），该方法将原子间势中的原子簇展开（ACE）适配到自推进智能体上。dACE提供了一个可系统性改进、严格等变的智能体加速度展开形式，能够唯一地分解为一体、二体、三体及更高阶的贡献，并包含一个刻画智能体自身过去运动的自项，该自项的拟合方式确保其不会吸收相互作用的影响。在具有已知规则的二维和三维模拟群体中，dACE能够从少量数据中逐阶恢复相互作用规律；而目前最接近的竞争对手——神经模型SocialNet——则需要更多数据，在多体规则或手性规则上误差大得多，且仅限于二维。在斑马鱼和金鲦鱼的真实追踪数据集上，该规律……
tldr: 本文提出方向原子簇展开（dACE）方法，将集体运动中的社会相互作用严格分解为一体、二体、三体等多体贡献，仅需少量轨迹数据即可逐阶恢复相互作用的体阶规律，并在二维和三维模拟群体及真实鱼群数据上全面优于现有神经方法SocialNet。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces dACE, an interpretable and systematically improvable expansion that uniquely decomposes collective-motion interactions into 1-, 2-, 3-body and higher contributions, recovering interaction laws body order by body order from few trajectories and outperforming SocialNet on both simulated 2D/3D collectives and real fish tracking data.
